name: memova
description: Run Memova workflows and set up user-owned raw-input roots from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Open Memova setup, automation tasks, and vault diagnosis.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP, then use @memova starter prompts and bundled skills to open a Memova menu, set up or diagnose an iCloud-first user-owned Memova raw-input root, review existing Codex automation tasks, run automation tasks linked to the latest ready note, request approval when needed, execute safe tasks, and write progress back to Memova.
